name: MIRO U
summary: MIRO U is Midea's wheeled industrial robot with six arms and a lifting, rotating body. The arrangement targets coordinated handling around manufacturing equipment. Midea reports pilot work in Wuxi, using a specialized multi-arm configuration to explore production tasks rather than reproducing a conventional two-armed human body.
